44.9.0.exception: Embedded Node 24.22.0 predates the October 2026 Node security release; the fixes ship in Node 24.22.1. No stable Electron release vendors Node >= 24.22.1 yet (44.9.0-44.9.3 and 45.0.0 all vendor 24.22.0 from the upstream tag per electron/electron DEPS). The maintainer explicitly accepted shipping one Node security patch behind. Re-review this entry when Electron upgrades its embedded Node runtime; replace with a PASS review once backport evidence exists.

notes: Entries are exact-version reviews keyed by Electron release. status PASS requires verified upstream backport evidence and application regression review. status ACCEPTED_RISK records a maintainer-approved exception with the accepted gap stated; it never claims the backport exists. An external Node update does not patch Electron.
